scope: All 17 competitive-landscape records and all ten fields; all 49 previously cited URLs inspected.
method: Read-only inspection of primary-source public web text and relevant official documentation. No product execution, accounts, live providers or security audit.
limitations: Inspection date is not publication or product-launch date. Web extraction may use recently crawled/indexed text.
Documentation/marketing establishes what sources state; it does not establish effectiveness, coverage or contractual security guarantees.
Not established in reviewed sources does not mean a competing capability is absent.
Allie differentiation fields are strategic proposals and do not establish exclusivity or implemented capability.
Mutable documentation and GitHub branches are not release-pinned behavior.
